desc: BGP — Send the Link-Local Next Hop capability in the BGP OPEN message to the neighbor.

title: neighbor PEER capability software-version
desc: BGP — Send the software version in the BGP OPEN message to the neighbor. This is very useful in environments with a large amount of peers with different versions of FRR or any other vendor.

title: neighbor PEER dampening [(1-45) [(1-20000) (1-20000) (1-255)]]

title: debug pim packet-dump
desc: Multicast — This turns on an extraordinary amount of data. Each pim packet sent and received is dumped for debugging purposes.

title: debug pim state-refresh
desc: Multicast — This turns on debugging for PIM state-refresh message processing. State-refresh messages are used in PIM dense mode.

title: ecmp
desc: Multicast — If PIM has the a choice of ECMP nexthops for a particular RPF, PIM will cause S,G flows to be spread out amongst the nexthops.

title: ecmp rebalance
desc: Multicast — If PIM is using ECMP and an interface goes down, cause PIM to rebalance all S,G flows across the remaining nexthops.

title: ip igmp
desc: Multicast — Tell PIM to receive IGMP reports and Query on this interface. The default version is v3.

title: ip igmp access-list ACCESSLIST4_NAME
desc: Multicast — Apply the indicated access list to filter incoming IGMP joins.

title: ip igmp generate-query-once [version (2-3)]
desc: Multicast — Generate IGMP query (v2/v3) on user requirement. This will not depend on the existing IGMP general query timer.

title: ip igmp immediate-leave
desc: Multicast — Immediately leaves an IGMP group when receiving a IGMPv2 Leave packet.

title: ip igmp join-group A.B.C.D [A.B.C.D]
desc: Multicast — Join multicast group or source-group on an interface. This will result in an IGMP join happening through a local socket so that IGMP reports will be sent on this interface.

title: ip igmp last-member-query-count (1-255)
desc: Multicast — Set the IGMP last member query count. The default value is the currently configured robustness value.

title: ip igmp last-member-query-interval (1-65535)
desc: Multicast — Set the IGMP last member query interval in deciseconds. The default value is 10 deciseconds.

title: ip igmp max-groups (0-4294967295)
desc: Multicast — Set the maximum number of IGMP groups that the can be joined on an interface.

title: ip igmp max-sources (0-4294967295)
desc: Multicast — Set the maximum number of IGMP sources to learn per group.

title: ip igmp proxy
desc: Multicast — Tell PIM to send proxy IGMP reports for joins occurring on all other interfaces on this interface.

title: ip igmp proxy route-map ROUTE-MAP
desc: Multicast — Apply a route-map to filter which multicast (S,G) entries are forwarded via IGMP proxy on this interface.

title: ip igmp query-interval (1-65535)
desc: Multicast — Set the IGMP query interval that PIM will use.

title: ip igmp query-max-response-time (1-65535)
desc: Multicast — Set the IGMP query response timeout value. If an report is not returned in the specified time we will assume the S,G or \*,G has timed out.

title: ip igmp require-router-alert
desc: Multicast — Only accept IGMP reports with the router-alert IP option.

title: ip igmp robustness (1-255)
desc: Multicast — Set the IGMP robustness value. The default value is 2.

title: ip igmp route-map ROUTE-MAP
desc: Multicast — Apply the indicated route map to filter incoming IGMP joins. The following match statements can be used: * match ip multicast-group A.B.C.D * match ip multicast-group prefix-list IPV4-PREFIX-LIST * match ip multicast-so…

title: ip igmp static-group A.B.C.D [A.B.C.D]
desc: Multicast — Add a static multicast group or source-group on an interface. This will behave as if there is a receiver on this interface without any IGMP reports.

title: ip igmp version (2-3)
desc: Multicast — Set the IGMP version used on this interface. The default value is 3.

title: ip igmp watermark-warn (1-65535)
desc: Multicast — Configure watermark warning generation for an IGMP group limit. Generates a warning once the configured group limit is reached while adding new groups.

title: ip mroute INTERFACE A.B.C.D [A.B.C.D]
desc: Multicast — Set a static multicast route for a traffic coming on the current interface to be forwarded on the given interface if the traffic matches the group address and optionally the source address.

title: ip mroute PREFIX NEXTHOP [DISTANCE]
desc: Multicast — Adds a static route entry to the Multicast RIB. This performs exactly as the ip route command, except that it inserts the route in the Multicast RIB instead of the Unicast RIB.

title: ip multicast boundary ACCESS-LIST
desc: Multicast — Set a PIM multicast boundary, based upon the ACCESS-LIST. If a PIM join or IGMP report is received on this interface and the (S,G) tuple is denied by the access-list, PIM will ignore the join or report.

title: ip multicast boundary oil WORD
desc: Multicast — Set a PIM multicast boundary, based upon the WORD prefix-list. If a PIM join or IGMP report is received on this interface and the group is denied by the prefix-list, PIM will ignore the join or report.

title: ip pim [sm | dm | sm-dm]
desc: Multicast — Enable PIM on this interface. PIM will use this interface to form PIM neighborships and start exchanging PIM protocol messages with those neighbors.

title: ip pim active-active
desc: Multicast — Turn on PIM active-active configuration for a Vxlan interface. This command will not do anything if you do not have the underlying ability of a MLAG implementation.

title: ip pim allow-rp [rp-list PLIST]
desc: Multicast — When processing a (\*,G) source list entry for a particular group in a Join message, RFC 7761 dictates that the source address must be set to the RP address.

title: ip pim allowed-neighbors prefix-list PREFIX_LIST
desc: Multicast — Only establish sessions with PIM neighbors allowed by the prefix-list.

title: ip pim assert-interval (1000-86400000)
desc: Multicast — Modify the PIM assert interval in milliseconds on this interface (defaults to 18000).

title: ip pim assert-override-interval (1000-86400000)
desc: Multicast — Modify the PIM assert override interval in milliseconds on this interface (defaults to 3000).

title: ip pim bsm
desc: Multicast — Tell PIM that we would like to use this interface to process bootstrap messages.

title: ip pim dm prefix-list PREFIX_LIST
desc: Multicast — Limit dense mode multicast to the range configured with prefix-list. By default there is no limit.

title: ip pim drpriority (0-4294967295)
desc: Multicast — Set the DR Priority for the interface. This command is useful to allow the user to influence what node becomes the DR for a LAN segment.

title: ip pim hello (1-65535) (1-65535)
desc: Multicast — Set the PIM hello and hold interval for an interface.

title: ip pim join-prune-interval (5-600)
desc: Multicast — Modify the join/prune interval that PIM uses on this interface. Defaults to the globally configured value (which in turn defaults to 60 seconds).

title: ip pim override-interval (0-65535)
desc: Multicast — Modify the PIM LAN prune delay override interval in milliseconds on this interface (defaults to 2500).

title: ip pim passive
desc: Multicast — Disable sending and receiving PIM control packets on the interface.

title: ip pim ssm prefix-list PREFIX_LIST
desc: Multicast — Configure the Source-Specific-Multicast group range. Defaults to 232.0.0.0/8.

title: ip pim unicast-bsm
desc: Multicast — Tell PIM that we would like to allow interface to process unicast bootstrap messages.

title: ip pim use-source A.B.C.D
desc: Multicast — If you have multiple addresses configured on a particular interface and would like PIM to use a specific source address associated with that interface.

title: join-filter route-map RMAP_NAME
desc: Multicast — Specify a route-map name to use for filtering incoming PIM joins. The following route-map match statements can be used: * match ip multicast-group A.B.C.D * match ip multicast-group prefix-list IPV4-PREFIX-LIST * match…

title: join-prune-interval (1-65535)
desc: Multicast — :daemon: pim Modify the join/prune interval that PIM uses to the new value. Time is specified in seconds.

title: keep-alive-timer (1-65535)
desc: Multicast — :daemon: pim Modify the timeout value for an S,G flow from 1-65535 seconds. If choosing a value below 31 seconds be aware that some hardware platforms cannot see data flowing in better than 30 second chunks.

title: msdp mesh-group WORD member A.B.C.D
desc: Multicast — Create or update a mesh group to include the specified MSDP peer.

title: msdp mesh-group WORD source A.B.C.D

title: msdp originator-id A.B.C.D

title: msdp peer A.B.C.D password WORD

title: msdp peer A.B.C.D sa-filter ACL_NAME <in|out>
desc: Multicast — Configure incoming or outgoing SA filtering rule.

title: msdp peer A.B.C.D sa-limit <AMOUNT>
desc: Multicast — Configure the maximum number of SAs to learn from peer.

title: msdp peer A.B.C.D source A.B.C.D [as AS_NUMBER]
desc: Multicast — Create a regular MSDP session with peer using the specified source address. Optionally the Autonomous Number (AS) can be provided for eBGP assisted loop detection (see RFC 4611 Section 2.1.

title: msdp shutdown

title: msdp timers (1-65535) (1-65535) [(1-65535)]

title: mtrace A.B.C.D [A.B.C.D]

title: no autorp discovery

title: packets (1-255)

title: register-accept-list PLIST

title: register-suppress-time (1-65535)

title: router pim [vrf NAME]

title: rp A.B.C.D A.B.C.D/M

title: rp keep-alive-timer (1-65535)
